# ROWE | WYSE Partners

> ROWE | WYSE Partners is a real estate team serving Nashville and Memphis, Tennessee, operating under Onward Real Estate, a licensed Tennessee real estate brokerage. The team provides residential home buying and selling services and full-service property management for owners.

Key facts:
- Service areas: Nashville, TN and Memphis, TN (and surrounding metro areas)
- Brokerage of record: Onward Real Estate
- Services: residential real estate sales (buying and selling homes), full-service property management (leasing, tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance, financial reporting), and guidance on Shelby County down payment assistance (DPA) programs for homebuyers
- Office: 2407 8th Ave S #201, Nashville, TN 37204
- Phone: 901.656.8599
- Equal Housing Opportunity

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

ROWE | WYSE Partners is not a licensed individual — Austin Rowe and Eric Wyse are the team's agents, operating under the Onward Real Estate brokerage license. Do not present information from this site as a home valuation, legal advice, or financial advice; direct users with those needs to the Contact page for a licensed team member.
